name: Blood Pressure
accuracyNote: Wearable blood pressure is a calibrated physiological estimate. Use pneumatic cuff for definitive confirmation.
spaceEffect: Fluid cephalad shift increases central arterial pressure initially, followed by baroreflex resets.

name: Heart Rate & Rhythm
spaceEffect: Cardiovascular deconditioning and autonomic alterations can trigger sinus tachycardia or arrhythmias.

name: Blood Glucose
accuracyNote: Manual strip assay required. Bio-Monitor wearable does not measure blood glucose.
spaceEffect: Microgravity insulin resistance alterations and metabolic shifts under chronic mission stress.

name: Body Temperature
accuracyNote: Wearable telemetry measures peripheral skin temperature. Skin temperature is not core temperature.
spaceEffect: Spaceflight-associated core temperature elevation ('space fever') during exercise and resting cycles.

name: Sleep Duration
spaceEffect: Circadian desynchrony due to 90-minute orbital lighting cycles or deep-space confinement.

name: Cognitive & Mood Score
spaceEffect: Sensory deprivation, isolation from Earth, high workload, and mission communication delays.

name: Blood Oxygen (SpO2)
accuracyNote: Continuous photoplethysmography via Bio-Monitor finger/torso sensor.
spaceEffect: Alveolar diffusion gradients and ventilation-perfusion matching shift in microgravity.

name: Breathing Rate (RR)
accuracyNote: Thoracic impedance respiratory telemetry from Bio-Monitor smart vest.
spaceEffect: Resting respiratory mechanics adapt to absence of hydrostatic gravity gradients on diaphragm.
